distribution.title:
The purpose of the data collection is to evaluate the sustainability of asphalt mixtures by linking laboratory mechanical performance testing with life-cycle–based sustainability assessment. The generated data will support the analysis of how different asphalt compositions, including mixtures with sustainable materials such as RAP or bio-based binders, influence pavement performance, service life, and environmental, economic, and social impacts.

The data will originate from laboratory testing of asphalt mixtures (e.g., fatigue, rutting, cracking resistance, moisture sensitivity) and from calculation-based models used for life-cycle assessment (LCA) and life-cycle cost analysis (LCCA). These data will be used to develop and apply a framework for performance-based sustainability evaluation of asphalt pavements.

dmp.description:
This Data Management Plan (DMP) relates to a research project aimed at assessing the sustainability of asphalt mixtures by linking laboratory-based mechanical performance testing with life-cycle–based sustainability evaluation methods. The study investigates various asphalt mixtures, including those incorporating sustainable materials and technologies, in order to evaluate their influence on service life as well as environmental, economic, and social impacts.
The project will produce laboratory test data and calculation results for life-cycle and cost analysis. This DMP explains how the data will be handled, stored safely, and shared when possible, ensuring clarity and good research practice.
